description:
Quote the current per-page rate and full book price in RUB, with account discount, without charging.

Pass book_id once get_book reaches status ready/sampled to quote the exact page_count and see the sample verdict
(take, complex or reject), or pass page_count before uploading a scan.

book_id.description: Owned book id (after splitting finishes) to quote its exact page count and sample verdict.
book_id.title: Book Id

page_count.description: Page count to quote before uploading a file (omit both fields to see the 1-page rate).
page_count.title: Page Count
